title: mcs note frontmatter
description: Language-neutral contract for mcs note frontmatter. The required set is what `mcs validate` enforces after a reconcile pass. A note with no frontmatter block is treated as 'not yet reconciled', not invalid.

id.description: Stable identifier, never renumbered. Format: <area>-<type>-<slug> (MADR convention).

type.description: What a note is (orthogonal to which folder it lives in). Each value traces to a published taxonomy.

status.description: Lifecycle state. MADR statuses collapse FDR + RFC into the `decision` type by status.

summary.description: One-line synopsis. Agent-backfilled from the note's first prose line when absent.

related.description: Optional cross-links by stable id (the portable link layer).

last_verified.description: Optional date a claim was last checked against its source (ISO 8601).
